reviews.title: Unprofessional app bad customer service
reviews.text: The app does not work well and is full of glitches. I paid for a room which I later needed to change the dates for and there was no one available to help. I ran into a glitch that made my booking unavailable to me from my account. No matter how hard I try, all I can get are automated messages describing the typical cancel process which is not my issues. This complete failure to handle a customer issue for a mostly broken service is going to cost me over $200. This app/service is absolutely NOT worth it - go somewhere else before they get you too!!!

reviews.title: Useless App
reviews.text: The latest update to this app is pure garbage.  You click on a property to view it and there is no back button! You literally have to reboot your device to look at a different property. Insane. I used to love this app. I deleted it and will just use the website.

reviews.title: Customer service/rebooking is impossible
reviews.text: The app will automatically select dates for a random date when refreshed. Once the booking is made, they make it impossible to change. Even if you notice within minutes after booking. Really frustrating when just going back to look at options, the dates automatically change. It’s a money grab and they know it.

reviews.title: App is shocking
reviews.text:
The website itself is fine for booking hostels but always check the hostel website itself as it is usually cheaper. 
The other problem I have is with the app, it is very clunky but most of it you can work with. The one thing that makes absolutely no sense and makes me want to stop using the app is that there is no back button once you have gone to view a hostel in more details!! I mean this is just stupid!! You have to make the whole search again from the start!!

reviews.title: Mis representation
reviews.text: The app recommended a particular hostel to me, which I duly booked. I then checked the hostel rules to realise I fell outside of their age range. I immediately cancelled the booking. No refund given from the hostel (yes I took the no refund price). I feel however, the app knowing my age, should never have offered the hostel to me as their recommended one to book. I was in a hurry to book, so trusted their recommendation. Hostelworld and the hostel refused to refund the full amount paid.

reviews.title: Put great features behind a paywall
reviews.text:
I can no longer access the traveller chat, which was an innovative feature this app had. This is because they’ve rolled out their social pass whereby you can access the chat without having a booking if you pay. 

Otherwise it tells you that you can make a booking to access the chat. The issue with this is I have 2 bookings right now and it still won’t let me access the chat.

So either this is a bug due to carelessness or they’ve just put a great feature behind a paywall.

reviews.title: Poor functionality, worse customer support
reviews.text: I’ve been trying to cancel a booking for days and the live chat never has agents and directs you to submit a request. You get an automatic reply and the agent who eventually replies repeats the same thing, like they didn’t even read your request / issue. There is no support call center so emailing is the only option. I’ve been having this issue for days and now I’ve lost my free cancellation and have to pay 100% of the cost of my booking when I can’t make it to the reservation, all because their support is horrible and the app keeps crashing when I try to cancel my booking.

reviews.title: Hotel prices
reviews.text: This app was great once upon a time…. But now, hostel dorms are costing the same as a hotel room on this app. I imagine it’s because of the fees built into the pricing on the app…. But the entire POINT of a hostel is cheap accommodation. Not spending $70-$100 per night to share a room with 4 strangers. What used to be a wonderful & rich travel experience has been bought out by corporate greed and greed has no limits. Well, I’m certain that soon people won’t be paying these prices since backpackers usually want to save money and have cheap accommodation, especially when sharing a room with a bunch of people.

reviews.title: App not functioning with latest version
reviews.text: I used to always love this app but the latest update keeps me stuck on the first hostal I check with no exit out. It’s so weird and frustrating. I never ever had this problem with previous versions. You also use to be able to check ratings by age and dates, but I don’t see that.

reviews.title: Unethical ways of handling business
reviews.text:
Have previously had a great experience with Hostelworld. However, my recent interaction with their platform has completely soured my initial, positive opinion of them. I booked a hotel where I wasn’t able to check-in due to specific terms and conditions. I rebooked with Hostelworld to another property in the same city. However, when requesting a refund for a hostel, that I did not even stay at (let alone checked in at), they denied the request several days later. This is absurd as when a service is not delivered upon, payment cannot be expected. However, they took their share of the cut (deposit), leaving the hostel itself without a single cent and me having to pay Hostelworld the deposit. I barely ever post reviews, but this predatory manner of doing business, is unethical and shameful, and therefore I must warn future users of the App.

Furthermore, their “4.9”- rating with over 50K ratings here on App-store is likely inflated as the public opinion of Hostelworld on online forums, is far less positive. I suspect they report and take down negative reviews as this one. If not, you have been warned.

reviews.title: They commit fraud
reviews.text:
Would not recommend using unless you want to get scammed. Bad customer service. I booked a trip for 7 people and once I paid the deposit, the price changed by +-£250. This is not acceptable as I would not have booked the hostel at that price. I disputed the amount straight away with evidence but it has taken them 3 days to reply to my dispute. When they did, they told me the total amount to pay and ignored my complaint and evidence. This caused the hostel to cancel my reservation. I am waiting to hear back and see if I will get a refund of my deposit. 
This is just illegal. I have the proof that they changed the amount post payment but they have ignored it so far.

reviews.title: 25% More than Booking Direct with Hostels
reviews.text: They overcharge by about 25% compared to booking direct with the hostels. I found this out after already booking about 3 weeks of hostels. I would understand a small service fee, but they charged 744 euros instead of 600 (the rate when booking direct through the hostel). 144 euros is an unreasonable service fee. Don’t make the same mistake I did.
